ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, the direction of ray $OA$ is $15^\circ$ east of north, and the direction of ray $OB$ is $40^\circ$ west of north. $OA$ is the angle bisector of $\angle BOC$. $OF$ is the straight extension in the opposite direction of $OB$. What is the degree measure of $\angle COF$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Since $\angle BOC = \angle AOB + \angle AOC$\\
$=55^\circ \times 2 = 110^\circ$,\\
then $\angle COF = 180^\circ - \angle BOC$\\
$=180^\circ - 110^\circ$\\
$=70^\circ$.\\
Therefore, the measure of $\angle COF$ is $\boxed{70^\circ}$.
